status: development-selected on the fully outcome-open open27 panel; frozen candidate only after this file is committed
claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc threshold-grid-selected development result on reconstructed proxy targets. It may nominate one candidate for a disjoint fresh-object test. It cannot establish covariance calibration, safety, official Deform360 parity, sensor-count reduction, or state of the art.

method.camera_budget_semantics: distinct dynamic RGB prefixes activated after all-view frame-zero planning, with four-view prefixes cached before escalation; not a full sensor-count ablation
method.routing_score: 90th percentile across covariance-valid centers of sqrt(trace(total triangulation covariance)) divided by the frame-zero all-point bounding-box diagonal
method.covariance_components: projection-Jacobian covariance plus leave-one-camera-out covariance when available
method.route_order: try four views, then eight views
method.accepted_route: use the selected budget measurement, frozen current-observation physical/persistence Chamfer selector, separate recursive RBF states, and exact HELD_RBF_CONFIG
method.double_rejection: bit-exact physical-prior forecast interval and no update to either recursive RBF state
method.covariance_interpretation: target-free ranking and abstention score only; no calibrated probability or coverage claim

development_camera_plan_accounting.prospective_requirement: use one frozen nested activation order so the four-view set is a strict prefix of the eight-view set

development_selection.disclosure: The threshold grid and selection rule were conceived after inspecting open27 outcomes and are post hoc.
development_selection.selection_rule: choose the largest grid threshold whose maximum per-case Chamfer regression versus physical is no greater than 10 percent and whose equal-case identity and Chamfer means are both no worse than fixed four views
development_selection.leave_one_object_out_interpretation: four of five folds select the same largest threshold; the blanket-held-out training fold admits no candidate and would fall back to fixed four views; this is stability evidence, not validation

known_covariance_miscalibration.consequence: never describe the routing score as calibrated uncertainty

implementation.prospective_sealing_boundary: This development evaluator is not a prospective sealer. Fresh measurements, covariances, routes, diagnostics, and prediction arrays must be durably sealed in a separate prepare phase before any target-scoring process is authorized.

prospective_promotion.current_authorization: do not open or reuse another protocol's reserved cohort
requirements: use a separately hash-selected object-disjoint cohort
freeze a nested four-to-eight camera activation rule before tracking
seal all target-free measurements, covariances, routes, and predictions before opening any future targets
make no threshold or feature change after fresh feature extraction
use equal object weighting and object-cluster inference
report automatic-twin failures and persistence fallbacks without outcome-dependent exclusion
